verdict.rationale: Brex's Bill Pay product covers every element of the story. Brex AI captures itemized invoice details, suggests the matching PO and drafts a payment (brex-docs-13). Multi-level approval flows route automatically by amount, vendor or role (brex-docs-11). Vendors can be paid by ACH, check or wire from any bank account or a Brex account (brex-docs-14), with vendor onboarding and a payments API backing this up (brex-docs-12, brex-docs-34). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AP workflow, and documentation of invoice capture beyond marketing-level claims (e.g. intake channels and accuracy).
